notes.title: Release Date Update: 2026
notes.content:
[p]Hellooo Cottage Dwellers!!
[/p][p]We know maaany of you are eagerly awaiting the release of Virtual Cottage 2. Right now, we are hard at work to get the game finished and we have some very cool features planned.[/p][p][/p][p]We are super excited for you to see what we've been cooking!!! [/p][p][/p][p]BUT it will take a little while longer until you can play it 😭 🙏  We are aiming for a Q2 2026 release. It's still too early for an exact date, and it might even take us a bit longer.[/p][p][/p][p]On the upside, we are already doing beta tests right now and are aiming to get a demo finished a lot sooner.  We look forward to all your feedback!! [/p][p][/p][p]And since this question comes up a lot: [/p][p]Virtual Cottage 2 will not be free. [/p][p]It will be a much bigger game than the first Virtual Cottage, but we have not decided on a price yet.[/p][p]If you'd like to be up-to-date with the development or leave us some more input, you’re welcome to join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/E2tR2mQ2KX"]discord[/url] :)

Thank you for your continued support ❤️

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2943180/Virtual_Cottage_2"][/dynamiclink]

[/p]
